note: Placeholder/all-zero barcode — must resolve to a clearly-labeled mock product, never a crash or a bare None.
Too short to be a real EAN/UPC — must still resolve gracefully.
Malformed/non-numeric barcode string — must not raise.
Empty barcode should be treated as 'no barcode given' by the Coordinator, not passed through to the API.
Sanity check: a real, well-known barcode (Nutella) should resolve to real Open Food Facts data, not the mock fallback.
